title: Add a top-10 rank buffer to equity weekly momentum; hold both sleeves this week
observation: Equity caps all clean (tech 29.74%, cash 20.98%, META 14.37%). The 63d screen keeps 7 of 8 holdings in its top 8; the only cohort change is XLV (rank 9, +3.00%) out and QQQ (rank 7, +3.81%) in, a 0.81 pt gap. Full rebalance to allocate.py targets would trade about $29.9k gross (~30% of NAV) for that. QQQ also overlaps MSFT/NVDA/AAPL/META/AMZN already held. Walk-forward 1y check: weekly top8 +3.66% (turnover 9.0x) vs same with top-10 buffer +5.54% (6.2x); last 3m buffer -3.22% vs -2.71% (mixed).
logic: Options: (1) book full allocate.py rebalance; (2) hold with no rule change; (3) adopt top-10 rank buffer (keep a holding while it ranks top 10, fill openings from top 8) and hold this week. Chose (3): cuts churn on near-tie ranks, standard momentum practice, 1y evidence positive, does not change the signal.
how_to_judge: Next four Mondays: weekly turnover, equity vs SPY, and a shadow no-buffer book in the scorecard. Drop buffer if it trails no-buffer by more than 1 pt over 4 weeks.
